name: TARS Robotics
name_zh: 上海它石智航技术有限公司
summary:
TARS Robotics (Tashi Zhihang) develops embodied intelligence and general-purpose robotics. Founded in 2025, the company works on connecting AI with physical interaction, including how robots learn manipulation skills from human activity.

Its World In Your Hands research ecosystem includes the Oracle Suite wearable data-collection system, a multimodal manipulation dataset and tools for annotation and evaluation. The project studies how human demonstrations can improve dexterous robot policies across varied objects and environments. Open research resources complement the company's broader development of embodied systems, linking data collection, model training and the execution of physical actions.
